Sanzo Wada was a Japanese textile and costume designer whose 1933 reference book, *A Dictionary of Color Combinations* (配色総鑑), catalogued 348 named colors alongside hundreds of pre-tested pairings meant to be visually harmonious together -- closer to a curated palette-pairing tool than a raw color list. Each base color in this mode's data is matched to one, two, or three other colors Wada specifically paired with it, giving combos of 2, 3, or 4 total colors.

Palette Jack's Wada mode lets you pick a combo size, randomize to one of Wada's own matched sets, and copy it straight into `scale_fill_manual()`.

## The combinations

```{r}
#| label: load-wada
#| message: false
#| results: asis
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

wada <- read_csv("../data/sanzo_wada_colors_long.csv")

swatch_html <- function(hex, name, cap = 8) {
  n <- length(hex)
  hex <- head(hex, cap)
  name <- head(name, cap)
  spans <- glue('<span class="mini-swatch" style="background:{hex}" title="{name}"></span>')
  out <- paste(spans, collapse = "")
  if (n > cap) out <- paste0(out, glue('<span class="palette-module-more">+{n - cap} more</span>'))
  out
}

# a base color's combo size is itself + however many colors Wada matched to
# it (one row per match) -- see R/prep-wada.R for the same logic documented
# and validated outside the render path
wada_bases <- wada |>
  group_by(color_name) |>
  summarise(color_hex = first(color_hex), n_matches = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(combo_size = n_matches + 1)

gallery <- wada_bases |>
  filter(combo_size %in% 2:4) |>
  group_by(combo_size) |>
  summarise(
    n_combos = n(),
    examples = paste(head(color_name, 4), collapse = ", "),
    swatches = swatch_html(color_hex, color_name),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(combo_size) |>
  mutate(label = glue("{combo_size}-color combo"))

cat(
  '<div class="palette-gallery">',
  glue_data(
    gallery,
    '<div class="palette-module">
  <h4>{label} <span class="palette-module-count">{n_combos} combos</span></h4>
  <p class="palette-module-desc">e.g. {examples}</p>
  <div class="palette-module-swatches">{swatches}</div>
</div>'
  ),
  '</div>',
  sep = "\n"
)
```

## How to use it

1. Pick a **combo size** -- 2, 3, or 4 colors.
2. Click **Randomize** to pull one of Wada's own matched combinations at that size.
3. Copy the R vector -- or the plain hex list -- straight into your plot.

## Try it

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("../data/sanzo_wada_colors_long.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// one entry per base color_name, its own hex, and its matched colors
// sorted back into Wada's original order (combo_index is internal only --
// never shown in the UI)
grouped = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(
    data,
    v => v.slice().sort((a, b) => a.combo_index - b.combo_index),
    d => d.color_name
  ),
  ([color_name, matches]) => ({
    color_name,
    color_hex: matches[0].color_hex,
    combo_size: matches.length + 1,
    matches
  })
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sizeOptions = ["2-color combo", "3-color combo", "4-color combo"]
sizeMap = new Map([["2-color combo", 2], ["3-color combo", 3], ["4-color combo", 4]])
viewof sizeLabel = Inputs.select(sizeOptions, {label: "Combo size", value: "2-color combo"})
comboSize = sizeMap.get(sizeLabel)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// base colors with no matches at this size are simply absent here
eligible = grouped.filter(d => d.combo_size === comboSize)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof shuffleSeed = Inputs.button("Randomize", {value: 0, reduce: v => v + 1})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
selected = {
  shuffleSeed; comboSize;
  return d3.shuffle(eligible.slice())[0];
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
combo = selected
  ? [
      {hex: selected.color_hex, name: selected.color_name},
      ...selected.matches.map(m => ({hex: m.combo_hex, name: m.combo_name}))
    ]
  : []
hexList = combo.map(d => d.hex).join("\n")
hexVector = 'c(' + combo.map(d => `"${d.hex}"`).join(', ') + ')'
hexSingleQuote = combo.map(d => `'${d.hex}'`).join(', ')
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function textColor(hex) {
  const c = hex.replace("#", "");
  const r = parseInt(c.substring(0, 2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(c.substring(2, 4), 16);
  const b = parseInt(c.substring(4, 6), 16);
  const lum = (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255;
  return lum > 0.6 ? "#241C1C" : "#FFFFFF";
}

html`<p style="color:#555;margin-bottom:.5rem;">Based on Wada's <strong>${selected ? selected.color_name : ""}</strong></p>
<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:1rem 0 1.5rem;">
  ${combo.map(d => html`<div class="color-chip" style="background:${d.hex};padding:12px;min-width:120px;min-height:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;color:${textColor(d.hex)}">
    <div style="font-weight:600;">${d.hex}</div>
    <div style="font-size:.82rem;">${d.name}</div>
  </div>`)}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
vectorCopyBtn = {
  const label = () => `Copy R vector (${combo.length})`;
  const btn = html`<button class="swatch-copy-btn">${label()}</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(hexVector).then(() => {
      btn.textContent = "Copied!";
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = label(); }, 1200);
    });
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
listCopyBtn = {
  const label = () => `Copy hex list (${combo.length})`;
  const btn = html`<button class="swatch-copy-btn swatch-copy-btn--secondary">${label()}</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(hexList).then(() => {
      btn.textContent = "Copied!";
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = label(); }, 1200);
    });
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="margin-top:1.5rem;">
  <p style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem;">1. Ready for <code>scale_fill_manual()</code></p>
  ${vectorCopyBtn}
  <pre class="hex-list-block"><span class="hl-fu">c</span>(${combo.map((d, i) => html`<span class="hl-st">"${d.hex}"</span>${i < combo.length - 1 ? ", " : ""}`)})</pre>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="margin-top:1.25rem;">
  <p style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem;">2. Or just the hex codes</p>
  ${listCopyBtn}
  <pre class="hex-list-block">${hexList}</pre>
</div>`
```
